summary.name: Upscale Image
summary.one_liner: A browser-based AI image upscaler that enlarges low-resolution photos and recovers detail for portraits, product shots, artwork, and old photos.
use_cases: Enlarging a small image for web or print
Sharpening soft selfies or client headshots
Preparing catalog photos for ecommerce listings
Restoring faded or blurry family photos
Batch upscaling a set of images at once
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI upscaler that runs in the browser and accepts JPG, PNG, and WebP files (up to 10 MB each), or a direct HTTPS image URL. Users choose a 2x, 4x, 6x, or 8x enlargement level and a mode suited to portraits, products, artwork, or restoration. Up to 10 images can be queued and processed as a batch with the same scale setting. A before-and-after slider lets users compare the original with the enhanced result before downloading. The page says 2x output is capped at 4096px / 6.0 MP and that results still depend on the source image quality.
notable: Batch queue for up to 10 images with one shared scale setting
Accepts direct HTTPS image URLs as input
Modes tuned for portraits, products, artwork, and old photo restoration
caveats: Page shows a credit counter (0 credits) and a 'free' listing tag, but credit costs and paid tier details are not stated on the page
Output quality depends on the original image, per the FAQ
Input limited to JPG, PNG, WebP at 10 MB per file; 2x output capped at 4096px / 6.0 MP
